data.title: fix: update elbow arrow on font size change #8798
data.body:
- fixes the [issue](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/8798) where arrows bound to text elements do not update their positions or bindings when the font size of the text elements is changed. 
- The solution ensures that the `updateBoundElements` method is called after the text elements are updated, synchronizing the arrows accordingly.
- Let me know if you’d like further refinement or if there’s anything else you’d like to add!

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5518d58-18f6-4095-aa35-7c0157fc09c2
